rubrics.criterion: Homepage presents Academo's centered white content wrapper, navy two-tier header, subject navigation, popular demo area, publication logo strip, and concise educational copy.
The /demos page presents exactly the scoped demo set: Virtual Oscilloscope, 3D Vector Plotter, Logic Gate Simulator, 19 TET Keyboard, and Flags of Europe.
Reusable demo cards preserve the original Academo card pattern: one 260 x 170 thumbnail image, one title, image opacity hover, and orange title hover feedback.
Category pages route locally and show the correct assigned demos, including /physics listing Virtual Oscilloscope and /flashcards listing Flags of Europe.

The interactive demo pages support core local behavior: Logic Gate Simulator provides draggable/connectable nodes and reference tables, 3D Vector Plotter provides editable vectors and computed vectors, 19 TET Keyboard provides playable Web Audio notes, Virtual Oscilloscope provides generated/live waveform controls, and Flags of Europe provides flippable/shuffleable flashcards with local flag assets.
